name: mdnav
description: Structure-aware navigation, byte-span addressability, and MCP server for Markdown corpora; evolving into a Markdown-documents REPL for an agent: typed claims over span algebra, addressed by path, delivered under a byte budget
comment: Manifest only. Node reads `type` by walking up from each source file, so this must sit at the package root and cannot live in brewery. Dependency pins and the lockfile live in brewery/node/; deps/node_modules is where they deploy and are consumed directly (src/deps.ts, tsconfig typeRoots, the typecheck script) without root junctions. `main` is the MCP server entry (TypeScript, run by Node directly -- unflagged type stripping is load-bearing, hence engines.node >=24). `bin` is the legacy single-file CLI, kept as the capability oracle (D22/D47) and never edited.
